title: Cosmic Third Eye Vision
description: A surreal black and white line art scene features a large central figure with three vertically stacked eyes on its face, the top eye containing a planet. The figure holds a detailed cosmic sphere showing galaxies and planets. Below, a lone hiker with a backpack walks along a path through a field of purple flowers toward geometric rock formations, while the starry night sky above contains constellations, a large black hole, and floating geometric shapes.
prompt: Surreal black and white line art illustration with selective purple and red accents. A towering central humanoid figure has three vertically stacked eyes on its elongated head, the top eye glowing with a planet, purple tears dripping from the middle eye. The figure holds a detailed cosmic orb showing galaxies and planets. In the foreground, a lone hiker with backpack walks a path through a lavender flower field toward geometric rock formations under a dark starry sky filled with constellations, a large black hole, and floating colorful triangles and geometric shapes.
